text:
emma: Heads-up: we have a regression where presigned S3 URLs pass through query auth and break downstream quota checks. Need to decide rewrite order: should we strip presign query params before header injection (client-id) and path normalization? cc @jon @sara
jon: I think strip presign first. They contain sig, expires, etc. They shouldn't affect cache keys or quota. Also avoid moving auth into headers for presigned requests.
sara: Agree. Also: canonicalize path (remove duplicate slashes, trailing slash) before computing cache key. That way ?version=1 stays separate but presign gets removed.
jon: Proposal: order = 1) path normalization 2) strip presign query params 3) header injections (X-Client-Id, X-Canary) 4) apply routing rules. Any objections?
emma: One concern: some proxies rely on Authorization header; if we inject X-Client-Id after stripping, the quota service reads header earlier in the pipeline. Need to ensure quota/telemetry hooks run after injection.
sara: We can add a small atomic phase boundary: rewrite_phase -> policy_phase -> telemetry_phase. Quota checks subscribe to telemetry_phase. Implementation detail: make telemetry_phase configurable per route.
jon: Example route config (sketch):
```
route: /uploads/*
  normalize_path: true  # strip dup slashes + trailing
  remove_query_params: ["X-Amz-Signature","X-Amz-Credential","X-Amz-Expires","X-Amz-Date"]
  inject_headers: {"X-Client-Id": "${client_id}", "X-Canary": "${canary_flag}"}
  phases: [rewrite, policy, telemetry]
  quota_phase: telemetry
  cache_key: normalized_path + headers:[user-agent, x-client-id]
```
jon: Note: cache_key intentionally excludes all signed query params.
emma: Also: preserve Host and X-Forwarded-For for tracing. Do NOT include any signed query tokens in logs. Mask them.
infra-bot: deploy: rewrite-order-rollout v1 -> canary target=10% started
emma: :thumbsup: let's roll to canary 10% and monitor token_leakage_count + quota_mismatch_rate alerts.
jon: I'll PR the change. Will add unit tests for normalize+strip order and an e2e that simulates presigned redirect.
sara: If tests pass, we promote after 24h unless alerts.
